claims.text: A remote scorer Signal automatically scores each individual LLM span, each tool span and the entire conversation.
It guarantees that all three levels receive scores even when the turn has not ended.

issues: S1 says the opposite: remote scorer signals score only completed agent turns (root span ended, weave.genai.turn_ended). Individual LLM and tool spans and whole conversations aren't remote scoring targets.
The claim of a guarantee of scoring when the turn has not ended is contradicted by S1; incomplete turns aren't scored.
Correct answer: each completed turn (root span with no parent) is scored. The signal's filters and sample rate apply, and the result is written as feedback on the turn.
Revise partial or unsupported material claims.
